_comment: M3.12 canonical snapshot of the Pareto-1 result for the paper. The 'winning' linearization variant is Sequential Talami (M3.8/M3.9), which recovered the entire M3.7 exhaustive Pareto front (4/4 matches, HV ratio = 1.0) at 64 / 192 sims. See plan/cpsat_validation_2026.md for the full M3.9 report.
winning_method_label: Sequential Talami (Block 1: orient x setpoint, Block 2: wall_r x roof_r)

objective_definitions.FR1: Comfort proxy (max occupied-zone air temperature surrogate via _fr1_proxy helper in run_simulation.py). Minimisation. To be redefined as discomfort degree-hours in Phase 3 / paper-2 (M3.11 deferred).
objective_definitions.FR2: Annual HVAC electricity demand (kWh/yr, ZoneAirCooled chillers + fans). Minimisation.

decision_parameters.deferred_dp_rationale: Glazing injection (M1.5/M1.6) is paper-2 scope. The current IDF has two hardcoded fenestration constructions; glass_u is solved by CP-SAT but NOT physically injected by the IDF patcher, so it is inert in EnergyPlus. For this reason glass_u is EXCLUDED from the GSA ranking and held constant at GLASS_U_FIXED = 2.0 W/m^2K throughout this paper's experiments. Any GSA score the variable might carry in the Morris dataset (gsa_results_20260518.json) reflects sampling noise of an inert input, not a physical sensitivity, and therefore is not cited as evidence of low impact. The variable's full integration is scheduled as future work alongside the window-construction catalogue (M1.5/M1.6) under the Phase 3 / paper-2 architecture.

provenance.location: Chicago O'Hare International Airport, IL, USA (TMY3)

future_work_pointers.glass_u_integration: Phase 3 (paper-2) under the unified architecture (Dantzig-Wolfe + NA-IPM + CP-SAT); design notes in context_docs/phase3_scaling/
future_work_pointers.fr1_refinement_to_degree_hours: M3.11, deferred to Phase 3 to avoid invalidating this snapshot's comparison with the M3.7 exhaustive ground truth
future_work_pointers.next_immediate_step: First sub-problem of the Dantzig-Wolfe master loop, reusing the marginal-tables linearization validated in M3.3 / M3.9 — see plan/notebooklm_briefing_2026-05-25.md and the NotebookLM recommendation in plan/notebooklm/round1_response.md

end_uses_provenance.source: eplustbl.htm 'End Uses' subreport, summing all energy columns (every fuel reported in [GJ]) and converting to kWh via 1 GJ = 1e9/3.6e6 kWh. The Water [m3] column is skipped.
end_uses_provenance.notes: Heating / cooling / fans / pumps separated to support paper-1 Section 4 defense (Round 2 of NotebookLM 2026-05-25 validation). Recomputed totals were checked against pareto_front[].hvac_energy_kwh_yr within 1%. 5ZoneAirCooled_Opt.idf uses Natural Gas for heating and Electricity for cooling/fans/pumps, so summing all [GJ] columns is required to reconcile with the total HVAC energy reported by run_candidate.
